map.进食态度测试(EAT-26)，筛查可能存在的进食/饮食障碍倾向。共26题，6级评: Eating Attitudes Test (EAT-26) screens for possible eating-disorder tendencies. 26 items, 6-point scale; total >=20 suggests eating-disorder concern needing further assessment.
map.EAT-26总分 = Σ26个条目（含反向计分条目按REVERSE/NORMAL: EAT-26 total = sum of 26 items (reverse-scored items weighted REVERSE/NORMAL); <20 low risk, >=20 suggests eating-disorder risk needing professional assessment.
map.本量表为自助筛查工具，不能替代精神科/营养科专业诊断。若存在暴食、催吐、极度限制: This is a self-help screening tool and does not replace psychiatric/nutrition diagnosis. If binge eating, vomiting or extreme diet restriction occurs, seek medical care promptly.
map.26 题按 NORM/REV 计分：假设合计 24，且第 4 题（暴食）或第 9: 26 items scored NORM/REV: assume total 24, and item 4 (binge) or item 9 (vomiting) reported 'often/always' -> reaches positive cutoff 20; refer to eating-disorder specialist.
map.合计 8 分且高风险题未触发 → 未达阳性，但持续关注体象认知。: Total 8 and high-risk items not triggered -> not positive, but keep monitoring body-image cognition.
map.总分 ≥20 或任一高风险项高频报告即提示进食障碍可能，需结合体重与进食行为面谈: Total >=20 or any high-risk item reported frequently suggests possible eating disorder; combine with weight and eating-behavior interview.
map.青少年与年轻成人筛查常用，男性亦可能阳性，勿只限女性。: Commonly used for adolescents and young adults; males can also be positive; do not limit to females.
map.进食(EAT-26)饮食态度评估器。医疗专业工具，基于权威医学标准，仅供参考。: Eating Attitudes Test (EAT-26). A medical professional tool based on authoritative medical standards, for reference only.
